purpose: Compare every pinned source hash against every independent witness this repository holds, and name the disagreements.

live.isNotComplete: Each leg's log is one API call returning its full job log. Sixteen were read: every distinct outcome shape in the run, all three pattern probes, and the Priority 1 asset. The other 28 are almost all further NC legs, which share the one refusal recorded here, but they are UNREAD and nothing below should be read as covering them.

whatADisagreementDoesNotEstablish: which of the two byte strings is the current official form
that the publisher revised anything — the pin may never have been of this document
that an asset with no witness is wrong; it is unwitnessed, which is a different problem
that an archive index hit means the bytes can be obtained today — the archives are not in this clone
